run_finetuning_trainer: run the hydra main entry point to fine-tune a causal LLM with LoRA on a dataset
train_model_with_lora: train a PEFT LoRA model using SFTTrainer on a DatasetDict with configurable epochs and batch size
evaluate_merged_checkpoint: evaluate a merged PEFT checkpoint on a validation dataset and compute token and action accuracy
compute_metrics_per_token: compute per-token and completion accuracy metrics from model predictions using MetricsAccumulator
tokenize_for_generation: tokenize an input text example into split input IDs and labels for autoregressive generation
